newsitem.title: UK: Norwich Union shares climb in grey market. [CORRECTED 15:32 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Norwich Union shares climb in grey market. [CORRECTED 15:32 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects description of company from building society to insurance group.)
Shares in UK insurance group Norwich Union, set to float shares on June 16, were bid at 342p and offered at 352p at 0940 GMT, City Index said.
The price has risen by more than 10 percent since trading started in the "grey" market at 310p on June 3, the financial and sports bookmaker said.
The shares were bid as high as 350p on Wednesday.
"There's been a lot of interest," said one dealer at City Index. "We've probably had four or five hundred calls on about it."
